notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard, then play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.
